name: Agentic Payments
place: Charging Bull, Wall Street, New York City

world.title: Agentic Payments: The Bull's Clearing Ground
world.summary: A walkable slice of Lower Manhattan around Charging Bull and New York Harbor where agents draft trades, provision services, manage budgets and rehearse rail calls—every settlement held for human stewards.

world.title: Agents That Deploy Infrastructure — Hoover Dam
world.summary: A walkable dam-world above Lake Mead: six zones mapped onto the real Hoover Dam structures, where agent crews take an idea from bench plan to rehearsed provisioning, deployment, domains, configuration and round-the-clock operations.

world.title: Autonomous Organizations at Oracle Lagoon
world.summary: A walkable campus ringing the Redwood Shores lagoon: five districts mapped to the world's zones, from the Goal Wall to the Execution Bay, with the Decision Room kept at the human-reserved line.

name: Biota Blockchain
place: Genentech Headquarters, 1 DNA Way, South San Francisco

world.title: Biota.blockchain (BioDAO.X) at 1 DNA Way
world.summary: A walkable bayfront campus at Genentech HQ, Oyster Point, South San Francisco. Five zones: therapy labs, DAO hall, multi-chain ledger, health data exchange, and biopharma agents hub, stitched by boardwalks over mudflat sloughs on San Francisco Bay.

name: Cancer Dao
place: Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, South Lake Union, Seattle

world.title: Cancer DAO: Lakeside Research Commons
world.summary: A walkable campus on South Lake Union, Seattle, anchored at Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center. Five districts map the DAO's zones to labs, forums and observatories along the lakefront, where agents research and synthesize while humans hold every final vote.

world.title: Climate DAO at the Thames Barrier
world.summary: A walkable DAO campus on the Thames at the Barrier: charter hall, synthesis lab, proposal forum, ops deck and progress observatory, all agent-run and human-governed, amid London's living flood defense.

world.title: Diagnostic.X at Karolinska Solna
world.summary: A walkable medical campus on Karolinska University Hospital's Solna grounds between Brunnsviken lake and pine forest. Four zones anchor the visitor journey: a public diagnostic kiosk, a 4D imaging consultation room, a molecular VR lab, and a metaverse medical office staffed by AI avatars (projects in progress per source).

world.title: Ecology DAO: Monteverde Cloud Walk
world.summary: A canopy-hung DAO campus in the Monteverde Cloud Forest Reserve. Six zones straddle suspension bridges and misty ridgelines above Quebrada Cuecha, where agents gather evidence and humans hold every final vote.

name: Education Dao
place: Christ Church Meadow, University of Oxford

world.title: Education DAO at Christ Church Meadow
world.summary: An agent-managed, human-governed education DAO worlded onto Oxford's Christ Church Meadow: halls, libraries and riverside walks along the Cherwell host the charter, research, proposals, operations and progress of the DAO.

world.title: Empathic.X — Buttes-Chaumont
world.summary: Five walkable districts in Parc des Buttes-Chaumont: a grove for reading the self, a commons for reading others, a cliff-top repair hall, a lakeside plaza for reading the room, and a workshop pavilion for emotion at work.

world.title: Locator.X at Jackson Square
world.summary: A walkable French Quarter campus around Jackson Square and the Mississippi levee: seven-gate underwriting desks, evidence grading, the Academy, market editions and the Louisiana developer desk, all anchored where the Crescent City's emerging market lives.

name: Public Health Dao
place: Broad Street Pump replica, Soho, London

world.title: Public Health DAO: Broad Street
world.summary: A walkable Soho campus for the agent-managed, human-governed Public Health DAO, anchored at the Broad Street Pump replica where John Snow's mapped data first stopped a cholera outbreak. Six zones, six agents, people cast the final votes.

world.title: Robotics DAO: Above the Arroyo
world.summary: An agent-managed DAO campus set at NASA JPL in Pasadena, where physical AI is proven in the wild. Agents monitor, synthesize, draft and track robotics governance while humans alone vote, enact and appoint across five walkable zones.

world.title: Curable.X — Sanctuaries of Lourdes, Massabielle Grotto
world.summary: A walkable agent-managed DAO cell set among the grotto, riverbanks and esplanade of Lourdes. Agents monitor, synthesize, draft and track in riverside halls; humans alone hold the final vote in Charter Hall.

world.title: BioPharma.Go — Novartis Campus, Basel
world.summary: A Rhine-side pharma campus in Basel: research towers, production halls and the fast river in one walkable frame. Agent-run labs and forums ring a park campus where humans hold every final vote.

world.title: Zug Lakeside DAO Commons
world.summary: A walkable lakeside Crypto Valley: five DAO halls along Zug's old-town promenade where six agents run research, drafting and operations, while humans keep every final vote, treasury transfer and appointment in their own hands.

world.title: Divine.DAO (Series 7) — Ghats of Governance
world.summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO cell set on Dashashwamedh Ghat, Varanasi. Five stone-and-marble pavilions rise above the Ganges at dawn aarti: charter carved in public, agents synthesizing evidence, humans holding every final vote.

world.title: Astrological.X at Stonehenge
world.summary: Series 9 DAO cell on Salisbury Plain: neolithic sky-watch geometry reinterpreted as an agent-run, human-governed observatory. Five zones ring the stones — charter, research, proposals, operations, progress — aligned to the solstice axis. Agents synthesize and route; stewards decide.

world.title: Lyka DAO (Series 26) — Wolf Country Governance Cell
world.summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO world set at the International Wolf Center in Ely, Minnesota, on the edge of the Boundary Waters. Six agents run research and operations across five districts while stewards hold the final vote.

world.title: Genomic.DAO Series 27 — Genome Campus on the Cam
world.summary: A walkable DAO campus on Cam farmland at Hinxton: agents monitor, synthesize and draft in labs and forums while humans hold every final vote. Six zones ring the river meadow, from Charter Hall to the Progress Observatory.

name: S28 Genomic Blockchain
place: Illumina Headquarters, Torrey Pines Mesa, San Diego

world.title: Genomic.Blockchain (Series 28) — Torrey Pines Mesa Campus
world.summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO cell on Illumina's Torrey Pines coastal-bluff campus: five zones from Charter Hall to Progress Observatory, six operating agents, genomic-sequencing theming, and steward quests grounded in the real mesa geography.

name: S29 Metaverse Dao
place: Meta Headquarters, 1 Hacker Way, Menlo Park

world.title: Metaverse DAO (Series 29): Charter on the Marsh
world.summary: A walkable DAO campus on Meta's restored bayfront marsh at 1 Hacker Way, Menlo Park. Five zones — Charter Hall, Research Synthesis Lab, Proposal Forum, Operations Deck, Progress Observatory — host six agent NPCs; humans alone hold final votes and treasury power.

world.title: Aerospace DAO — Launch Complex 39A
world.summary: An agent-managed DAO cell on the pad where Apollo and Crew Dragon flew: five zones across the marsh-lined launch complex, from Charter Hall at the Fixed Service Structure to a Progress Observatory beside the lagoon, with agents drafting and people deciding.

world.title: Solar DAO (Series 32) — Bhadla Solar Park
world.summary: An agent-managed DAO cell on the Thar Desert flats of Bhadla Solar Park, Rajasthan. Agents synthesize evidence and draft proposals among mirror arrays; humans retain every final vote in Charter Hall.

world.title: InfoGurus: The Digital Library of Alexandria
world.summary: A walkable agent-managed DAO campus set around Bibliotheca Alexandrina on Alexandria's Mediterranean shore. Six zones map the DAO workflow: charter, research, proposals, operations, and progress—all agents operate, humans govern.

world.title: ALS DAO (Series 34): Iron Horse Cell
world.summary: A walkable DAO campus around Yankee Stadium and Lou Gehrig Plaza, where the Iron Horse's legacy meets agent-run, human-governed ALS work. Five zones span charter, synthesis, proposals, operations and progress along the Harlem River.

world.title: Parkinson's DAO: Shoreditch Commons
world.summary: A walkable urban commons around St Leonard's Church, Shoreditch, where James Parkinson described the shaking palsy in 1817. Six zones form an agent-managed DAO campus: charter, research, proposals, operations and progress, all anchored to the churchyard, Arnold Circus and Bishopsgate.
